strings.name: Julia Roberts
strings.summary: Roberts moved from early roles in Mystic Pizza and Steel Magnolias to global recognition with Pretty Woman. She expanded across romantic comedy, social drama and thrillers. Erin Brockovich won her the leading-actress Oscar; television work includes The Normal Heart and Homecoming. Her enduring screen presence and choices continue shaping women’s stories in popular cinema.

strings.influence.rationale: Through Pretty Woman, Erin Brockovich and other films she shaped independent female characters and has long influenced global popular film culture.
